name: Scala Quaranta
description: Scala Quaranta is a rummy card game that involves melding, sets, runs. The game originated in Italy and has become popular worldwide.

history.origins:
Country/Region of Origin: Italy
Time Period: Traditional Italian card game
Historical Development: Popular Italian rummy game (Scala 40) with similarities to North European Kalookie; played with double deck of standard cards.
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game in Italy.
timeline: Modern Era: Continues to be played worldwide
